# Inline External Key Annotation Parsing

This feature implements a deterministic parser for extracting inline external key annotations (marked with # kc:external-key: <key>) from source files. It supports the annotation of classes and functions, enabling mapping of local symbol names to external keys for use in stable identification and architectural concept preservation.
